arms.D: Both direct-compiled head groups; pure weight edit
arms.DB: Only D Belief row applied to C
arms.DQ: Only D continuation rows applied to C
arms.D_gated: D if frozen new-VAL rule accepts, otherwise exact C
arms.G: Both matched-objective PGD head groups; pure weight training
arms.G_gated: G if frozen new-VAL rule accepts, otherwise exact C
arms.J: Complete own-law Bellman policy table including own terminal posterior; structural planning control
arms.P: C continuation, exact own analytic deadline-six terminal posterior; structural-only control
arms.R: Single norm-matched random edit on both groups
arms.R_gated: R if frozen new-VAL rule accepts, otherwise exact C

incumbent.definition: Read exact published coefficients from exploratory_belief/OLD_CONTINUATION_HEADS.json.gz at research_commit; reconstruct the candidate JSON and match its recorded full file SHA256; never re-solve lambda to recover C
incumbent.fallback: If exact C cannot be recovered, stop protocol preparation rather than silently switch to A
incumbent.name: C

information_boundary.evaluation: Frozen independent finite environment transition tables with the original TRAIN-fitted confusion; full expected-trajectory recursion. No FullHX packet I/O, no live Trader or true hidden path input to policy.
information_boundary.planner_inputs: Original fitted checkpoint compiled transition tables, coordinates, prior convention, TRAIN-fitted confusion, public schedule and completed observation history only
information_boundary.scope: Optimality only for finite supplied checkpoint law and declared decoder; not unknown true law or real trading.
information_boundary.supervision_scope: Program-teacher distillation from the fitted checkpoint model; no unsupervised/no-data claim
information_boundary.table_authority: Use exact stored tables; do not silently regenerate from raw/nominal law. Unknown dt/drive rejected. Own table-law prior/emission/posterior must match original NumpyPolicy.

optimization.budget_per_group: L2 update <= 0.5 * original C-group norm. Numerical solver uses inward factor (1-1e-8); serialized F64 update checked with exact rational squared norms against both declared and numerical balls.
optimization.deployment_numeric_scope: Actual stored F64 JSON head and original NumPy execution. No F32 full-graph or production qualification.
optimization.diagnostic_scope: Numerical KKT, Cholesky and Frank-Wolfe diagnostics, not outward-error mathematical optimization certificates. Exact stored-IEEE group norms are separately verified.
optimization.direct: One spectral secular-root trust-region solution per group; block Hessians for continuation share a multiplier. Cholesky and KKT/FW checks independent of spectral formula.
optimization.gradient: Same objective, same C origin, same inward radius, projected GD with spectral 1/L step; each group stops on its own FW gap <=1e-8, maximum 100000 steps. No direct optimum used for stopping.
optimization.objective_per_group: weighted squared target residual + lambda * squared L2 distance from C group
optimization.random: One deterministic random update per fit with separate group norms matching D, no validation search

purpose: Compile complete supplied-checkpoint-law Bellman continuation values and terminal belief into the original head; distinguish structural planning, representability, numerical solution and task efficacy.

reporting.cost: Report acquisition/preparation separately; CPU/wall/RSS for state enumeration, own-law compilation, features, each solver, serialization, validation, test evaluation and recovery. Shared costs charged once; no inferred USD/energy or full-training speedup. Every arm/world starts with its own empty feature cache; warm weight/table residency is explicit. J full cold compile, table verification, serialization, load and subsequent lookup are all separate and their cold total is recorded.

efficacy_gate.structural: All source/Bellman gates pass AND both Bonferroni primary J-C domain lower bounds strictly exceed .005
efficacy_gate.utility_scope: Original finite-task utility includes requested-read, repair and simulated elapsed fees; actual DP/solver CPU has no measured economic conversion and is reported separately
efficacy_gate.weight: All numeric/source gates pass AND both Bonferroni primary D_gated-C domain lower bounds strictly exceed .005

reporting.interval: 5-fit paired Student-t; two-sided Bonferroni4 familywise alpha=0.05. No equivalence/zero-effect claim on failure.
reporting.outer_process_receipt: wait4 worker user+system CPU includes imports and final writes; controller own CPU and elapsed wall retained separately; summary internal timer excludes later serialization overhead
reporting.preservation: Original source/model/core/input-layer/decoder bytes untouched; only 196 declared head numbers differ; exact group reset reconstructs incumbent semantics and source identity; rejected gates use C exactly
reporting.secondary: All raw/ablated/gradient/random per-fit utilities and descriptive 95% intervals; actual policy visits; selected-Q error, ordering/margin regret, posterior probability MSE, original task fees, reads/repair and latency counts
reporting.unknowns: Five existing fits, finite task and known evaluation law; not new full-model refits, external/open-domain/market confirmation or universal global weight optimality

resource_caps.execution_platforms: POSIX supervisor on Linux/macOS; this resource-limited runner is explicitly not a Windows supervisor
resource_caps.overrun_behavior: Preserve partial records and fail the qualification; no silent reduction of fits/worlds or restart with changed protocol
resource_caps.rss_target_scope: Measured peak RSS target, not an operating-system hard address-space limit; reported separately

source.additional_research_scope: 32-fit digital_feedback confirmation report; all benefit and overall quality gates failed. Its task is a separate fixed-physics feedback family. No records are used as labels or validation.
source.model_input_identity: Original five model and TRAIN/VAL JSON SHA256 values from joint/INPUT_ACQUISITION.json; validate archive and member hashes before use.

task_semantics.cost: all requested-read, repair and elapsed-time fees on the original task transition path
task_semantics.read: observes current latent sign at request completion tick; failed completion breaks sensor
task_semantics.repair: repairs sensor only; no CTMC reset intervention
task_semantics.target: sign at fixed tick 6, not first passage
task_semantics.tie_break: first legal action in original action order, numpy argmax

training.collection: Enumerate all structurally lawful nonterminal full states in each original TRAIN world, retaining actual sunk charges. Continuation weights: 1/(number of worlds * number of states in that world with any legal continuation * number of legal continuation actions at that state). Belief weights: 1/(number of worlds * all full states in that world).
training.collection_order: Deterministic DFS stack; original action order; failure,0,1 completion append order. Full-state canonical bytes define uniqueness; states are not sorted before accumulation.
training.features: Original 85->48 tanh hidden features plus bias, same frozen representation/core/decoder
training.public_worlds: All 64 original TRAIN schedules per fit; no original VAL used for new selection
training.targets: Complete own-law Bellman Q for legal WAIT/READ/REPAIR; logit of own-law deadline-six posterior for Belief, clipped only to [1e-12,1-1e-12] before logit with clip count reported
training.weights: Two separate convex problems: continuation loss normalized per world/state/legal-continuation; Belief logit loss normalized per world/state. No cross-group logit-versus-Q scale tradeoff.

validation_and_test.distribution_scope: OOD is relative to original TRAIN. New OOD validation exposes that distribution during selection; TEST is fresh instances, not an entirely unseen distribution.
validation_and_test.existing_feedback_confirmation: Never used as new holdout; already-exposed research permanently listed.
validation_and_test.gate: Relative to current C: mean of new IID and OOD VAL gains >=0.005 AND each VAL domain gain >=0. No test-driven selection; gate decisions committed before test evaluation.
validation_and_test.generation: Full SHA256 domain-separated seed from frozen protocol identity, fit, split, domain and purpose; recorded PCG64 seed integer and complete public schedules
validation_and_test.history_exclusion: Before any scoring, compare schedule-content identity excluding id/packet placeholders against original TRAIN/VAL, all recovered WSP history including final compile test schedules, and reconstructable newer research history; duplicates stop the run without replacement. Record inaccessible history and separate task schemas explicitly.
